features.title: Keep the original conversation toolbar and child views inside each thread
features.summary: Every fixed conversation hosts the original Rich Composer header inside its own retained SessionProvider: title/mode, contributed workspace utilities, Pin and thread actions, and native Chat/Trajectory/Traces/Requests navigation when those providers are present. The original header child has one declarer behind a reusable owned Factory, shared with native mode; no borrowed renderer or global-following duplicate is used. Native selected views drive the existing content/composer instead of a forced Chat view. The original right-sidebar opener uses the registered Workbench dock actions, not the hidden native carrier. Outer Workbench tab layout, original blank hero and independent view-only panels retain their owners.
failureModes: Optional header utilities and child-view tabs appear only when their original owners are installed and the original session phase allows them.
Header actions address the panel's retained Session, never whichever other conversation happens to be globally selected.

telemetry.reason: Client-only composition of original authorized header/body renderers and existing dock actions. All original settings, session actions and resource I/O remain delegated to their existing providers; no new Host work.

features.title: Close the right pane when its final tab closes
features.summary: Closing the final actual right-pane tab, including its empty chooser, closes the existing browser-owned right pane instead of replacing it with a chooser. Other tabs and right-owned floating windows keep it open. Explicit manual reopen supplies one chooser; an explicit resource/view open can adopt directly. Reload retains closed visibility. Completed native mutation observation avoids transient-zero close during moves and layout restoration; the permanent main grid keeps its separate chooser policy.

features.title: Hide a single tab row without hiding its view
features.summary: Right-click the sole tab or blank row space and choose Hide tab row. Its original docked content and input stay mounted; a hover/keyboard Show tab row control and the global Workbench: Show tab rows command recover it. Native hideHeader persists in the existing layout JSON. A second tab added or dropped into the content reveals the row and clears the hidden preference; returning to one tab does not automatically hide it. Multiple-tab groups cannot be hidden.
failureModes: The native edge-shell variant does not restore hideHeader and is not offered this action; owned root/nested Workbenches use ordinary grid groups.
Content context menus are not intercepted; the tab/blank row, local content control and global command are the presentation entry points.

features.title: Root-pane windows float across the application
features.summary: Float panel and native Shift-float keep the same pane API, panel and renderer but move native chrome and persistent content through window coordinates. Main, left, right and bottom floats can leave their source pane, overlap with native chrome/body interleaving and per-window focus order, resize and reload, and their tabs can dock through the existing cross-region owner. Nested paint-contained surfaces remain local. Hiding a source pane retains native descendant visibility semantics rather than inventing another floating resource owner.
failureModes: Only root Dockviews escape ordinary frame-column overflow; registered nested content keeps its paint containment.
Legacy local float coordinates may shift on first use of window space, but native viewport bounds keep the window reachable without resetting the layout.

features.title: Workbench as the main conversation surface
features.summary: One fixed Session-bound conversation tab contains both native chat history and the real text-input editor. Sidebar clicks open a closed conversation as a new kept tab or focus its existing tab; other tabs never follow global selection. Closing all tabs leaves the docked chooser, not a resurrected global conversation. Legacy global-following aliases retire without changing fixed tab identity. Genuinely empty fixed Sessions use the native centered welcome, workspace/model controls and original composer; unsent drafts do not turn them into active transcripts. Loading history settles without a false welcome, and the first real turn becomes normal scrollable chat without replacing the editor.

configuration.constraints: Hidden legacy decode-only field; explicit native values no longer select a renderer. The centre always uses the Workbench.

features.title: Choose plugin views and one Settings hub

Conversations open only from the thread list or New thread, never as a separate Rich Composer/current-conversation choice. Search matches full qualified names; special ordering uses stable IDs. Restored reusable panels refresh their captions without changing IDs or remounting, while user conversation, scoped and resource titles remain untouched. Empty right/bottom panes and semantic Start use the same chooser; Settings leaves and runtime occurrences are not primary suggestions.
